Selected files from the Anatomy skill kit, supplied at
`/home/box/agent-data/workflows/anatomy/`, licensed MIT per its `SKILL.md`.

Included: `iso-kit.mjs`, `audit.mjs`, `lathe.mjs`, `tube.mjs`, and
`scripts/inline-kit.mjs`. The latter's kit-directory resolution is adapted
to the vendored flat directory. Geometry helpers and audit implementation
are otherwise unmodified. No author or copyright notice was present in
the supplied source files; this records the source and declared license.
